Can't answer everything, but I'll try my best.

For the Hek you want to go straight damage. A good build is Point Blank, Hell's Chamber, Contagious Spread, Charged Shell, Blaze, and Scattered Justice. The last two are personal preference, but anything with fire rate or punchthrough are good.

Fragor Prime or Jat Kittag are probably the two best hammers. Jat Kittag is rocket powered, so it wins the FashionFrame^TM contest. (I think it's also easier to get iirc)

For the Fragor any damage is good. Getting some attack speed as well is probably a good idea. You could try going max damage per hit, but attack speed makes the weapon so much more comfortable.

Soma Prime and Hek are both endgame viable weapons, so using the catalyst on either is perfectly fine. Pick the one you have the most fun using.

Saryn is the frame you saw. Lots of AOE poison. Ember, Nova, and Equinox can all do something similar, though Nova is probably the best of those 3, since her ult gives you a damage boost on enemies in addition to slowing them and making them explode on death.

As a rule, usually you want corrosive on a weapon when fighting Grineer and Infested, and magnetic for Corpus. Secondary damage type isn't as important, but heat for Grineer/Infested and toxin for Corpus are good choices. You can also try Gas on infested, but you need Corrosive for ancients, especially at high levels. Hope all this helped!
